title: Pope Leo calls for being ‘profoundly human’ in the age of AI

summary: 教皇利奥十四世发布首道通谕《崇高人性》，聚焦人工智能时代如何捍卫人类尊严。通谕警告AI武器化、劳动替代等风险，呼吁建立新的法律与伦理框架。这是梵蒂冈首次系统阐述AI伦理立场，并与Anthropic等机构合作，标志着宗教界深度介入AI治理讨论。

title: Anthropic's march to profitability
raw_excerpt: Anthropic is on track to do $10.9 billion in Q2 revenue, up from $4.8 billion in Q1, growing faster right now than Zoom did at the peak of the pandemic. The thing that flipped them to profit is compute getting cheaper, 71 cents of compute per revenue dollar in Q1, 56 cents in Q2. Claude Code on its own is at $2.5 billion in revenue, and the company expects to clear $559 million in profit just in time for its October IPO. The "AI labs burn money forever" story finally has a hole in it.
summary: Anthropic预计Q2营收达109亿美元，环比增长127%，并有望在10月IPO前实现5.59亿美元盈利。核心驱动力是计算成本下降（每美元营收计算成本从Q1的71美分降至56美分）以及Claude Code单产品贡献25亿美元收入。这一数据打破了“AI实验室永远烧钱”的叙事。

title: Lance (Hugging Face Repo)
raw_excerpt: Lance is a lightweight native unified multimodal model that supports image and video understanding, generation, and editing. It delivers strong performance across image generation, image editing, and video generation benchmarks with just 3B active parameters. The model was trained entirely from scratch within a 128-A100-GPU budget. Examples of clips generated by the model are available in the repository.
summary: 字节跳动发布Lance轻量级统一多模态模型，仅3B激活参数，支持图像/视频理解、生成与编辑，在多项基准上表现强劲。模型完全从零训练，仅使用128块A100 GPU，展示了小预算下训练高性能多模态模型的可能性。

title: The 2026-07-28 MCP Specification Release Candidate
raw_excerpt: The release candidate for the next Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification is now available. It is the largest revision of the protocol since launch. The candidate introduces a stateless core that scales on ordinary HTTP infrastructure, extensions, authorization that aligns more closely with OAuth and OpenID Connect deployments, a formal deprecation policy, and many other changes. It contains breaking changes. The final specification will ship on July 28.
summary: MCP协议发布2026-07-28版本候选，这是协议自推出以来最大修订。引入无状态核心、普通HTTP基础设施扩展、与OAuth/OpenID Connect更紧密的授权对齐，以及正式弃用策略。包含破坏性变更，最终规范将于7月28日发布。

title: David Sacks's 11th-Hour Plea Led to Trump's Backtrack on AI Executive Order
raw_excerpt: David Sacks, a venture Capitalist, warned President Trump on a call that the long-awaited executive order on the dangers posed by artificial intelligence that Trump was deliberating on could lead to mandatory regulations that slow down the industry in its race with Chinese competitors. Trump responded that he shared concerns about China and was worried about hindering AI investment. He then postponed the signing and told reporters he wouldn't sign the order. The incident shows how powerful Sacks' influence is and marks a win for those against strong guardrails to limit the risks posed by the technology.
summary: WSJ报道，风险投资家David Sacks在最后一刻致电特朗普，成功阻止了原定签署的AI行政令。Sacks警告该命令可能导致强制性监管，拖慢美国AI产业与中国的竞争。特朗普随后推迟签署，标志着AI行业游说力量的一次重大胜利。

title: Anthropic prepares Mythos 1 for Claude Code and Claude Security
raw_excerpt: Anthropic appears to be moving Claude Mythos to broader availability, with the model now helping protect a wider range of organizations. Traces of the model have already surfaced on Google Cloud and AWS through vulnerability discovery programs. A release for Mythos 1 seems imminent. Claude Opus 4.8 is also rumored to be in the works for release.
summary: Anthropic准备将Mythos 1模型更广泛地开放，该模型已通过漏洞发现计划在Google Cloud和AWS上出现痕迹，用于保护更多组织。同时，Claude Opus 4.8也传闻即将发布。Mythos系列是Anthropic的安全专用模型，此次开放标志着其安全能力的产品化。

title: Bumblebee Goes Open Source
raw_excerpt: Perplexity open-sourced Bumblebee, a read-only security scanner that identifies risky packages, extensions, and AI tool configurations on developer machines.
summary: Perplexity开源Bumblebee只读安全扫描器，可识别开发者机器上的风险包、扩展和AI工具配置。该工具旨在帮助团队在开发阶段发现安全漏洞，支持多种AI开发环境。开源策略有助于社区贡献和广泛采用。
